Class Sport

java.lang.Object
model.events.Event
model.events.Sport
public class Sport extends Event
Represents a Sport event in the TicketMiner system. Extends the abstract Event class.

      public Sport(int id, String type, String name, String date, String time, double vipPrice, double goldPrice, double silverPrice, double bronzePrice, double generalAdmissionPrice)
      Constructs a Sport event with the specified scheduling and pricing details.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique numeric identifier for the sport event
      type - the event type
      name - the name of the sport event
      date - the scheduled date (MM/DD/YYYY format)
      time - the scheduled time (hh:mm AM/PM format)
      vipPrice - the price for a VIP ticket
      goldPrice - the price for a Gold ticket
      silverPrice - the price for a Silver ticket
      bronzePrice - the price for a Bronze ticket
      generalAdmissionPrice - the price for a General Admission ticket
